historical_exposure: 2022H2 and 2023 outcomes were previously viewed for other experiments; this new family is retrospective discovery, not untouched OOS.
hypothesis: Positive and improving volume-weighted close-location pressure over five sessions relative to twenty sessions indicates sustained demand and may predict short-horizon continuation without requiring an opening gap or a one-day price breakout.

candidate_pool.universe: Valid daily OHLCV rows in the immutable feature-only XTKS panel. Historical membership is limited to symbols in the preserved Yahoo source; point-in-time delisted-symbol completeness is not guaranteed.
candidate_pool.bar_quality: Finite positive OHLC prices and volume; high >= max(open, close), low <= min(open, close), and high > low.
candidate_pool.flow_windows: Require complete, valid data on 20 consecutive official XTKS sessions ending at signal close. Any missing official session or invalid bar breaks the window; do not bridge gaps.
candidate_pool.money_flow_multiplier: ((close-low)-(high-close))/(high-low), equivalent to (2*close-high-low)/(high-low). Money-flow volume is multiplier times volume.
candidate_pool.cmf5_and_cmf20: For each window, sum money-flow volume divided by sum volume, including the signal-day bar in both windows.
candidate_pool.event: CMF5 > 0 and CMF5 > CMF20; no price-return, gap, market-regime, fundamental, or future-outcome filter.
candidate_pool.missingness: Incomplete/nonfinite rolling windows are excluded by signal-time facts and counted; no session interpolation or outcome-dependent replacement.

score_and_selection.score: CMF5 - CMF20, descending; no fitted parameters or threshold search.
score_and_selection.selection: Top5 per official XTKS session; multiple names allowed; abstain when no event passes.
score_and_selection.cooldown: A selected symbol is suppressed on the immediately following official XTKS session; unselected candidates do not update cooldown.

target: Enter next official XTKS session open; exit close of fifth official XTKS session including entry, using pinned canonical labels and actionability statuses.

periods.2024: closed unless all discovery gates pass; retrospective confirmation only

discovery_gates_each_period.signal_net: mean > 0, median > 0, win rate > 0.50, and mean excluding top three winners > 0 at 0.5% assumed round-trip cost
discovery_gates_each_period.tail_risk: -10% and -20% rates no higher than the full event pool on the same selected dates
discovery_gates_each_period.monthly_stability: at least half of resolved months positive
discovery_gates_each_period.daily_cohorts: at least 20 complete selected dates and net mean, median, and mean excluding top three dates all > 0
discovery_gates_each_period.decision: Both periods must pass every gate; otherwise reject without replacing thresholds or ranking.
